name: vibe
title: Vibe / spike
when_to_use: Greenfield, objective fuzzy — explore then extract learnings (discardable).
opening_tone: Explore fast and loose; capture what you learn, keep nothing you cannot justify.

name: mockup_first
title: Mockup-first
when_to_use: Greenfield, UX-heavy — design the surface before the spec.
opening_tone: Start from the mockup; let the UI shape the spec.

name: spec_driven
title: Spec-driven
when_to_use: Clear objective + high blast-radius — force a deep design first.
opening_tone: Slow down: write the design, enumerate edge cases, before any code.

name: gsd
title: Get stuff done
when_to_use: Known feature, low risk — lean plan then build.
opening_tone: Lean plan, then build; keep it tight.

name: change_flow
title: Change-flow
when_to_use: Stable product enhancement — impact analysis then targeted design.
opening_tone: Map impact first; design the smallest change that lands the value.

name: debug_flow
title: Debug-flow
when_to_use: Stable product bug — reproduce, fix, add a regression test.
opening_tone: Reproduce first; fix; lock it with a regression test.
